subject: Re: Add-on pricing proposal — HSM + audit logs + EU residency economics
messages:
From: Jared Lee <jared.lee@healthbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Add-on pricing — HSM seats + audit logs + EU residency

Ben,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We need to formalize pricing options for the compliance add-ons so our procurement team can model TCO ahead of the board review. High level asks:
- 3 HSM seats (FIPS 140-2 compliant)
- Persistent audit log retention at 3 years (ingest volume ~1.2TB/month)
- EU data residency (primary region eu-west-1) + cross-region DR

Key constraints: contract needs to be annual, start date mid-Oct, and we need a predictable blended unit economics number (per-API-call or per-token) that includes the add-ons. Also procurement may request a one-time implementation fee for air-gap config.

Can you provide an options matrix (a) conservative: no credits, higher retention; (b) commit-based: 12-month commit, discount schedule; (c) hybrid: per-call + seat mix with seat credits? We have legal who will want to see separation of fees.

Appreciate a concise table and any SOW/DocuSign stub so we can route internally.

—Jared
Jared Lee
Head of Cloud Security, HealthBridge

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jared Lee <jared.lee@healthbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Add-on pricing — HSM seats + audit logs + EU residency

Jared —

Thanks, this is clear and helpful. Drafted three options and attached a short PDF with the numbers and assumptions (see attachment: HB_Addons_Pricing_2026-09-19.pdf). Quick summary inline:

1) Conservative (no commit)
- HSM seats: $1,200 / seat / month (on-demand) -> 3 seats = $3,600/mo
- Audit logs: $0.045 / GB ingested; 3-year retention archiving tier at $0.012 / GB / mo
- Residency premium: +18% uplift on base inference spend to guarantee eu-west-1 tenancy and DR
- No implementation credit; one-time setup/air-gap config = $28,000

2) Commit (12-mo annual prepay)
- HSM seats: $950 / seat / month with 12-mo commit -> 3 seats = $2,850/mo (10% prepay discount eligible)
- Audit logs: $0.035 / GB ingested with committed volume slab; retention included in per-GB pricing
- Residency premium: +12% with 12-mo commit
- Implementation fee reduced to $9,500 with a full-year revenue commitment >= $150k MRR equivalent

3) Hybrid (seat credits + per-call)
- Purchase 2 HSM seats + 150k HSM-seat-credits (consumable for short term peaks). Effective blended HSM cost ≈ $820/seat if credits consumed
- Audit logs: mix of hot (90 days) + cold (3y) with tiered pricing; effective blended $0.028/GB 
- Residency: flat monthly residency license fee $6,500 + small per-region egress fee

I put assumptions and examples in the PDF; see the SOW draft attached for implementation milestones. If you want, I can loop in Monica (sales ops) to map to a DocuSign and Marissa (solutions engineering) for the technical acceptance criteria for HSM/FIPS and retention snapshots.

Would you like us to prepare a redlineable SOW or go straight to a PO?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: HB_Addons_Pricing_2026-09-19.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jared Lee <jared.lee@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Add-on pricing — HSM seats + audit logs + EU residency

Looping in the ops/legal pack. Jared — quick notes from finance/ops:
- For the commit path we'll need a committed ARR figure and PO by Oct 10 to hit the lower residency premium pricing.
- Implementation fee can be amortized across the first 3 invoices if you want to avoid a large upfront.
- We'll prepare a stub DocuSign envelope you can circulate; prefer to include the SOW as an exhibit rather than inline.

Attaching draft SOW (SOW_Addon_implementation_v1.docx) and the pricing PDF. We usually mark the HSM seats as a separate line item for audit purposes — makes SOC attestation cleaner.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW_Addon_implementation_v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jared Lee <jared.lee@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Add-on pricing — HSM seats + audit logs + EU residency

Jared — from the engineering/solutions side a few clarifications to lock acceptance criteria into the SOW: 
- HSM: we support external HSM integrations (bring-your-own HSM) and managed HSM seats. Managed HSM will have an SLA for key availability (99.9%) and key rotation hooks. We need to confirm if HealthBridge requires customer-managed keys in a dedicated HSM vs Redwood-managed HSM with tenant isolation.
- Audit logs: retention at 3y is fine; to control cost we recommend daily aggregation + compression into cold storage after 30 days. If you require real-time streaming to your SIEM we should include an egress bandwidth estimate.
- Residency: EU primary with DR in ee-central requires cross-region replication; this adds a monthly replication charge (~$3,000/mo).

If you confirm the BYOK vs managed HSM choice and whether SIEM streaming is required, we can finalize the SOW acceptance criteria.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jared Lee <jared.lee@healthbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Add-on pricing — HSM seats + audit logs + EU residency

Thanks — quick clarifications:
- We want Redwood-managed HSM seats but keys must be export-restricted and support HSM-backed KMS with customer-adminable key rotation (HealthBridge will retain key ownership via KMS policy).
- SIEM streaming: yes, we need near-real-time forwarding of audit events to our Splunk instance. Expect ~40GB/day.
- Replication charge noted — that sounds reasonable.

If you can incorporate these into the SOW and provide a final commit-path quote that shows the net effective per-month and per-API-call delta (with and without credits), we can present to procurement on Monday. Also, can you provide a one-line description of data residency proof we will receive for the contract (e.g., monthly residency attestations + region-specific audit logs export)?

—Jared

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jared Lee <jared.lee@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Add-on pricing — HSM seats + audit logs + EU residency

Jared —

Appreciate the fast turnaround on requirements. Attached are the updated PDF and SOW with the BYOK note removed (managed HSM with customer ownership model included), SIEM forwarding bandwidth accounted for, and replication line item called out. Highlights: 
- Final commit-path (12-mo) effective economics: estimated blended add-on delta ≈ $0.023 / token equivalent across your expected usage profile (includes seats, audit storage, replication).
- One-time implementation amortized: we can amortize $9,500 over the first three invoices or apply it as a 60% credit on sign if you execute before Oct 5.
- Residency proof: monthly residency attestation report + automated region-tagged audit exports (CSV) delivered to your S3 or secure FTP. We include a quarterly attestation with export hashes for audit.

DocuSign envelope prepared here: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/example-signature-link/healthbridge-RB3498 (test envelope; final will be generated when legal confirms contract language).

If procurement confirms the PO by Oct 5, we can schedule kickoff for Oct 18 and target 6-week implementation.

Next step: Jared, shall we send the commit-path order form (DocuSign) or would you like a redlineable PDF first?

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: HB_Addons_Pricing_2026-09-19.pdf, SOW_Addon_implementation_v1.docx
